BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

5. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.

6. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.

7. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.

8. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.

9. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Windows.

10. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Water Supply and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Information and Communication Technology

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.

3. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.

11. A — CPU

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
